_about: The Cat Hint Lines, the open line bank (docs/handoff-2026-10-22.md §6, and the Claude Doc 'Cat Hint Lines'). Every line is written and Jon may see them all; only which one plays, and which wrong family or motive it names, is the case's. [MOTIVE], [MOTIVES], [FAMILY] and [BONUS] are filled in by the game, always with wrong answers. Irwin has no lines here.

salem.about: 1 to 3 always the 'was' line (backwards: it points AT a wrong answer), 4 a coin flip, 5 always the 'wasn't' line (straight). Act 2 by family; Act 4 by motive, on the group's average.

bathroom.was: Hmph. Nobody at the big house ever asks the groundskeeper. Way I see it, and I see things from a funny angle, this whole cat-astrophe started in the bathroom. Now get off my lawn.
bathroom.wasnt: Huh. Somebody listened to the help for once. Way I see it, and I see things from a funny angle, it weren't the bathroom. Now scat.

food.wasnt: Well, look at that, a guest with manners. Way I see it, and I see things from a funny angle, it weren't about food. Now scat.

slights.wasnt: Huh. You're alright, for a houseguest. Way I see it, and I see things from a funny angle, nobody got embarrassed over this one. Now scat.

granolia.about: Never lies; the less she likes you, the more she forgets. 1 nothing, 2 half a motive name, 3 one motive, 4 two motives then loses the third, 5 the whole family. All acts; Act 4 on the group's average.

levels.1: Oh! Oh, hi! Hi. Sorry. Hi. Nobody ever comes in here. Well, Zimothy did once, but he was lost. *heavy breathing* Okay, so, I know something. I definitely know something. I read it in a book. Or I licked it in a book? Those feel the same sometimes. *snort* Anyway, it was about... it was... Do you like my study? I've licked most of it. Wait, why are you here again? Anyway, I hope this was helpful!
levels.2: Hi! You came! *heavy breathing* Okay, okay, I remember this one. It wasn't [HALF]. You know the one. Can I sit on you?
levels.3: You're my favorite. Don't tell the other cats. They don't talk to me anyway. *snort* It wasn't [MOTIVE]! I wrote it down. Then I ate the paper. But I'm sure!
levels.4: You smell amazing. Is that weird? That's weird. *heavy breathing* Okay! Not [MOTIVE]. Not [MOTIVE2]. And not... ooh, it was right there. It's gone. Want to see a hairball?
levels.5: I love you. Sorry, too much? I love you. *snort* I remember EVERYTHING today! Not [MOTIVES]! *heavy breathing* Wow. I need a lie-down. On you, ideally.
